Name: Silent Shipping Bins
Author: beebeettv
Description:
[b][size=5]Now supports Stardew Valley 1.6 & requires Content Patcher instead of Custom Music[/size][/b]

[center][size=3]Tired of squeaking every time you walk by a shipping bin?[/size]
[size=3]This simple mod replaces sounds for shipping bins with silence.[/size][/center]

[b][size=4]Updating from the original version[/size][/b]

Please ensure you [b]delete the old version of the mod[/b] and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] if you don't have it already.
Custom Music is no longer required.
